operations.content:
---
name: "limitfunction-contract.md"
description: "Observed index.d.ts declaration; limitFunction return type picks clearQueue and onIdle."
type: project
---

Observed source excerpt from "index.d.ts":

```text
export function limitFunction<Arguments extends unknown[], ReturnType>(
	function_: (...arguments_: Arguments) => PromiseLike<ReturnType>,
	options: Options
): ((...arguments_: Arguments) => Promise<ReturnType>) & Pick<LimitFunction, 'clearQueue' | 'onIdle'>;
```

newMemories.name: onidle-contract.md
newMemories.content:
---
description: p-limit's onIdle() resolves when active slots and the waiting queue are both empty.
type: project
---

`index.d.ts` declares `onIdle: () => Promise<void>;` on `LimitFunction`. `index.js` defines `onIdle` on the limiter and forwards it onto the function returned by `limitFunction` via `Object.defineProperty(limitedFunction, 'onIdle', {value: limit.onIdle})`. The limiter returns `Promise.resolve()` when already idle; otherwise it stores resolvers until `activeCount === 0` and `queue.size === 0`. A reserved slot counts as active because `resumeNext` increments `activeCount` before `queue.dequeue().run()`. The idle check is deferred with `setTimeout(..., 0)` so promise-continuation enqueues are observed before resolving. `clearQueue` also schedules an idle check after clearing when no jobs are active and waiters remain.

newMemories.name: tsd-default-test-file.md
newMemories.content:
---
description: Project tsd step targets index.test-d.ts, not test-d/ files, when index.test-d.ts exists.
type: project
---

In `package.json`, the `test` script is `xo && ava && tsd`. In the inspected `tsd` source, `findTestFiles` first globs the typings-derived `index.test-d.ts` / `index.test-d.tsx`; if that glob finds a file, it returns those files and does not glob the configured `test-d` directory. This checkout contains `index.test-d.ts`, so a new `test-d/*.test-d.ts` file is not picked up by the default `pnpm test` unless passed with `tsd --files`.
